default: # Verisource **Fact-checking and proper citations for AI assistants.** Verisource is an agent skill that makes Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini and Antigravity check claims against credible sources before stating them, and cite those sources in the style you need. - 🔎 **Source credibility.** Sources are rated in tiers: government data and peer-reviewed research first, content farms and anonymous pages never. YouTube is judged by who uploaded the video, not by the platform. - ✅ **Fact validation.** Each claim is labelled ✅ verified, ⚠️ disputed, ❌ contradicted, or ❓ couldn't verify, with links. Important claims need two independent sources, and five sites copying one press release count as one. - 📚 **Real citations.** APA 7, MLA 9, Chicago 18, Harvard and IEEE. Citations for papers with a DOI are built from the official DOI record, so authors, volume and pages aren't made up. A fake DOI gets caught. - 🚫 **No invented sources.** If something can't be verified, it says so. > Verisource **reduces** hallucinations and makes unverified claims visible. It doesn't eliminate them, so check anything important yourself. ## Install ### Coding agents (full version, including the DOI citation script) | App | Install | |---|---| | **Claude Code** | `/plugin marketplace add allanbest/verisource` then `/plugin install verisource@verisource` | | **Claude Cowork** | Customize → Plugins → Add marketplace → `allanbest/verisource` | | **Codex** (CLI / IDE / app) | `codex plugin marketplace add allanbest/verisource` then `codex plugin add verisource@verisource` | | **Antigravity** | `agy plugin install https://github.com/allanbest/verisource` | | **Gemini CLI** | `gemini extensions install https://github.com/allanbest/verisource` | Any other tool that reads `.agents/skills/` or `~/.agents/skills/` can use it too: copy `skills/fact-check/` there. ### Chat apps Download the zips from the [latest release](https://github.com/allanbest/verisource/releases/latest), or build them yourself with `./scripts/build-zips.sh`. | App | How | |---|---| | **Claude.ai** | Customize → Skills → upload `verisource-claude.zip` (needs code execution turned on) | | **Gemini app** | Customize → Skills → Create → upload `verisource-gemini.zip` | | **ChatGPT** (plans with Skills) | Plugins → Skills → Create → upload `verisource-claude.zip` | | **ChatGPT custom GPT / any chatbot** | Paste [`chat/instructions.md`](chat/instructions.md) into the instructions box (it's under 8,000 characters). Optionally attach [`citation-styles.md`](skills/fact-check/references/citation-styles.md) and [`source-credibility.md`](skills/fact-check/references/source-credibility.md) as knowledge files. Also works in Claude Projects and as custom instructions. | ## Choosing a citation style Just say it: *"use MLA"*, *"Chicago footnotes"*, *"IEEE please"*. To make a style the default, add this line to a `.verisource` file in your project, or to your `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `GEMINI.md` or chat custom instructions: ``` citation_style: mla ``` Options: `apa`, `mla`, `chicago`, `chicago-author-date`, `harvard`, `ieee`, `links`. If no style is set, it asks you once for school work, then uses APA 7. ## Example > **You:** i saw a youtube video saying humans only use 10% of their brain. is this true?? > > **Claude:** No, it's a well-known myth… *(followed by a fact-check table citing MIT McGovern Institute, Scientific American and the British Psychological Society, plus tips for judging that kind of video next time)* ## How it was tested The [evals](evals/fact-check) folder has 5 test cases: a homework paragraph with planted myths, a citable statistic for an essay, a YouTube claim, an MLA works cited request, and a fabricated citation. Each was run with and without the skill: | | With Verisource | Without | |---|---|---| | Checks passed | **25 / 25** | 21 / 25 | | Answers that searched and linked sources | 5 / 5 | 3 / 5 | | Average time | ~3.3 min | ~40 s | The skill's main gain is that it always checks and always shows its sources. Without it, the model often answers from memory with no links. The cost is time. ## Repo layout ``` skills/fact-check/ the skill (same folder for every platform) SKILL.md instructions references/ source-credibility + citation-style guides scripts/cite_doi.py DOI → formatted citation (APA/MLA/Chicago/Harvard/IEEE) chat/instructions.md paste-in version for chatbots without skill support .claude-plugin/ Claude Code + Cowork plugin and marketplace .codex-plugin/, .agents/ Codex plugin and marketplace plugin.json portable Agent Plugins manifest (Antigravity, Codex) gemini-extension.json Gemini CLI extension evals/ test cases scripts/build-zips.sh builds the chat-app zips into dist/ ``` ## License [MIT](LICENSE)
